question: Refer to the exhibit. A network engineer must create an EEM script that saves a copy of the running configuration to bootflash and writes a message to syslog when a user saves the configuration to a Cisco Nexus 9000 Series Switch. Which command completes the configuration set?
context:
event manager applet local-backup
  event cli match "copy running-config startup-config"
  action 1 cli copy <blank> bootflash:/current_config.txt
  action 2 syslog msg Configuration saved and copied to bootflash
  action 3 event-default
